notes_for_editor: Thin record: two lists and no dated events. Two searches returned nothing about this site (results were other Devil's Peak and Devil's Head towers, plus a 1993 notice for Valley Springs Peak, which is a different site). The story body is about 60 words, below the 120-word floor, because nothing more is sourced; it was not padded. Record fields agree with both sources (lat/lon, county, agency, gone status). Fact-check 2026-10-10: removed the unsourced 'ground-level structure' gloss from the story, because the FFLA page has no legend for the Ground type, and added the second source to the first sentence. Worth trying: Stanislaus National Forest records for former lookouts and Calaveras County historical society files.
